briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 push AGI frontier as compute race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple high-capability models this month amid record funding. Geopolitical tensions over chip exports continue to shape the landscape. Prompt injection attacks remain prevalent in deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI launched o4 with advanced reasoning; xAI deployed Grok-4 on expanded Colossus cluster; Google released Gemini 3.0 preview; Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B weights; DeepSeek-V3 reached top benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines emphasize multi-agent security protocols.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC reports 2nm yields improving for AI accelerators; Microsoft and Oracle announce joint 5GW data center campus; NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 500k units shipped.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed frontier systems by end of 2027?
